data.description:
Update skip-review-check.sh to read dso.workflow instead of enforcement.strategy, and update github-bootstrap.sh to read dso.workflow instead of merge.strategy.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh
- tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh
- tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh

## Implementation: skip-review-check.sh (line 97)
Current:
  _ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY="$("${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" enforcement.strategy 2>/dev/null || true)"

Replace with:
  _WF="$("${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")"
  
And update the comparison (find where _ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY == "ci" is used) to check _WF == "ci-pr" instead.

## Implementation: github-bootstrap.sh
Current (lines ~93-103):
  _read_strategy="$(grep '^merge\.strategy=' "$_CONF" ... )"
  _MERGE_STRATEGY="${_read_strategy:-direct}"
  if [ "$_MERGE_STRATEGY" = "pr" ]; then

Replace with:
  _WF="$(bash "$_CONF_SCRIPT" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")"
  if [ "$_WF" = "ci-pr" ]; then

where _CONF_SCRIPT is the path to read-config.sh (resolve from SCRIPT_DIR).

## Test Updates (must FAIL before implementation)
- test-skip-review-check.sh: update configs from enforcement.strategy=ci to dso.workflow=ci-pr
- test-github-bootstrap.sh: update configs from merge.strategy=pr to dso.workflow=ci-pr

## Bundling Rationale (Gate 3)
These two scripts are bundled because: (1) both are simple single-line functional changes; (2) each alone doesn't produce independently verifiable behavior beyond the grep test; (3) their test files are both simple config-substitution updates following the same pattern.

## Story DD Coverage
This task contributes to DD1 (zero grep matches for enforcement.strategy and merge.strategy in scripts)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh
- [ ] No functional reference to enforcement.strategy or merge.strategy in these scripts
  Verify: ! grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy\|merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: UPDATE: skip-review-check.sh + github-bootstrap.sh — read dso.workflow
